intro_paragraphs:
Octel Networks architects and integrates enterprise network infrastructure across offices, branches, campuses, and remote sites. Our framework brings LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and Wi-Fi together with integrated routing, segmentation, security, and redundancy, with each layer engineered around application requirements, traffic patterns, availability, and future capacity.

Most networks are built once and left to age, with security added only after something has gone wrong. We start with an assessment of your actual environment, not assumptions, and build every layer in order — physical connectivity, then routing, then performance optimization, then security.
portfolio_subtitle: Integrated connectivity and security built as one framework, not separate installs
portfolio_cards:
ri-router-line | LAN & WAN | Structured cabling, Layer 2/3 switching, and VLAN-based segmentation build a resilient local network, extended by resilient WAN links with automatic failover the moment a primary path degrades.
ri-route-line | SD-WAN | Centrally orchestrated overlay tunnels across MPLS, broadband, leased lines, and 4G/5G, with application-aware routing that prioritizes business-critical traffic in real time.
ri-shield-keyhole-line | Next-Gen Firewall | Application-layer inspection and integrated threat intelligence protect the network from the edge inward, with threats contained early through LAN segmentation.
ri-wifi-line | Wi-Fi & Security | Predictive site surveys and heat-map planning place access points for real-world coverage and capacity, with seamless roaming as users move between them.
whatwedo_heading: Why Organizations Choose Octel for Network Infrastructure
whatwedo_items:
Assessment-First Design | We start with an audit of your actual environment, not assumptions or a fixed template.
Layered Build Process | Physical connectivity, routing, performance, and security are engineered in sequence, each supporting the next.
Built-In Headroom | Every network is designed with capacity for future sites, devices, and traffic growth.
Security by Design | Next-gen firewalls and segmentation are part of the architecture from day one, not added later.
Centralized Visibility | Ongoing monitoring keeps your team informed of network health, not guessing.
outcome: A network that's reliable today and structured to defend and scale tomorrow.

intro_paragraphs:
Business communication only works when every user, office, and remote location can reach each other without friction. Octel Networks designs IP telephony that keeps your organization connected, whether people are in the office, at home, or on the move, with call management, presence, and collaboration sitting on a single platform from the start.

Most business phone systems are deployed office by office, with messaging, conferencing, and call management added on separately over time. We design telephony around your organization as a whole, with a centralized IP-PBX or UC platform handling call routing, extensions, and IVR from day one, scaling across every site rather than requiring separate systems per location.
portfolio_subtitle: Voice, messaging, presence, and conferencing on one platform your entire organization runs on
portfolio_cards:
ri-smartphone-line | IP Phones & Endpoints | Enterprise IP phones, extensions, and softphones matched how each user communicates, provisioned and standardized across every device and location.
ri-phone-line | IP-PBX & Call Management | Centralized call routing, auto attendant, and IVR flows, linked to service providers through SIP and VoIP connectivity, with call recording for compliance.
ri-team-line | Unified Communications & Remote Access | Voice, messaging, presence, and conferencing on a single platform, with remote and mobile users connecting securely with the same experience as being in the office.
whatwedo_heading: Why Organizations Choose Octel for IP Telephony

One Platform, Not Scattered Tools | Call management, presence, and collaboration run on a single platform from day one.
Built to Scale Across Sites | SIP and VoIP connectivity extend consistently across every office and branch.
Seamless Remote Access | Remote and mobile users connect with the same experience as someone at a desk.
Business App Integration | The platform extends into CRM and Microsoft Teams where needed, rather than sitting apart.
Compliance-Ready Recording | Call recording supports monitoring, compliance, and quality management wherever required.

intro_heading: Surveillance Built as an Intelligence Layer
intro_paragraphs:
Surveillance is only as useful as what it lets your team act on. Octel Networks designs and deploys intelligent IP video systems — from cameras and recording infrastructure to video management and analytics — that turn footage into real-time visibility and actionable security insight across every site.

Most camera systems only capture footage after something's already happened. We design surveillance around detection and response: camera selection matched to each environment, AI analytics running at the edge to flag events as they occur, and a centralized video management platform tying every site into one environment your team can monitor and search.
portfolio_subtitle: Cameras, recording, and analytics working together to detect events, not just archive them
portfolio_cards:
ri-camera-line | IP Camera Systems | Fixed, dome, PTZ, and thermal cameras matched to each environment's lighting, distance, and the specific activity each area needs monitored.
ri-hard-drive-2-line | Recording, Storage & Edge Processing | Recording infrastructure sized around camera count, resolution, and retention needs, with edge processing reducing bandwidth and speeding up detection.
ri-eye-line | Video Management & AI Analytics | A centralized platform brings live monitoring, recording, and playback together, with AI analytics detecting people, vehicles, and defined events as they happen.
ri-links-line | Multi-Site Management & Integration | Centralized management unifies cameras across every branch and facility, integrated with access control, alarms, and perimeter security.
whatwedo_heading: Why Organizations Choose Octel for Video Surveillance

Detection-First Design | Systems are built to flag events as they happen, not just record them for later review.
Environment-Matched Cameras | Fixed, dome, PTZ, and thermal cameras are selected based on actual site conditions.
AI-Driven Analytics | Edge processing detects people, vehicles, and defined events in real time.
Unified Multi-Site View | Centralized video management brings every site location into one monitored environment.
Integrated Security Ecosystem | Surveillance connects with access control, alarms, and perimeter security instead of standing apart.
built_for: Real-Time Detection | Multi-Site Visibility | Scalable Storage | Integrated Response

We assess current exposure first, then implement controls proportional to actual risk — not a one-size-fits-all product bundle — and keep monitoring in place after deployment.

ri-lock-2-line | Endpoint Protection | Antivirus, EDR, and device hardening across laptops, desktops, and servers.

intro_heading: Network Health Managed as One View
intro_paragraphs:
A network you can't see is a network you can only react to. Octel Networks provides centralized network management, using Netka-based capabilities to give IT teams visibility across every device and connection, so issues are caught and resolved before they affect the business, not after.

Most organizations only look closely at their network when something's already broken. We deploy Netka-based network management to discover every device and map how they connect, with real-time and performance monitoring, centralized fault and event management, and configurable alerts that flag issues as they emerge.
portfolio_subtitle: Visibility into every device and connection, from one centralized platform
portfolio_cards:
ri-map-2-line | Discovery & Topology | Netka-based discovery identifies network devices automatically and maps how they relate across your infrastructure, replacing a static inventory list.
ri-dashboard-3-line | Real-Time & Performance Monitoring | Continuous tracking of health and availability across switches, routers, firewalls, and wireless infrastructure, all from one platform.
ri-alarm-warning-line | Fault, Alerts & Traffic Visibility | Centralized fault and event management with configurable alerting, plus bandwidth visibility to flag congestion before it causes slowdowns.
ri-bar-chart-2-line | Reporting & Capacity Planning | Operational, performance, and capacity dashboards, with trend analysis that supports infrastructure decisions before growth outpaces capacity.
whatwedo_heading: Why Organizations Choose Octel for Network Management

Netka-Based Visibility | Centralized monitoring covers every switch, router, firewall, and wireless device from one platform.
Real Topology Mapping | Devices are discovered and mapped, giving IT teams a real picture of the network, not just a list.
Proactive Fault Detection | Alerts flag issues as they emerge, before they escalate into outages.
Capacity Planning | Bandwidth and traffic trends inform infrastructure decisions ahead of time.
Actionable Reporting | Dashboards and reports turn network data into planning decisions, not just historical logs.

intro_heading: The Physical Foundation Every Network Depends On
intro_paragraphs:
A network is only as reliable as the cabling and connectivity beneath it. Octel Networks designs and installs end-to-end passive infrastructure — structured copper cabling, fiber-optic backbones, racks, patch panels, and cable management — built to organize today's connectivity and absorb tomorrow's growth.

Most physical infrastructure is installed to pass initial testing and left alone — undocumented and difficult to trace once something needs to change. We start with a site survey and engineering plan, install with proper labeling and patch-panel architecture from day one, and hand over every project with full documentation and certification.
portfolio_subtitle: A physical layer engineered for performance, easy troubleshooting, and clean expansion
portfolio_cards:
ri-plug-line | Structured Copper Cabling | Cat6 and Cat6A cabling connects end-user devices, access points, IP phones, and cameras, planned around actual endpoint density and future device growth.
ri-flashlight-line | Fiber Optic Backbone & Termination | Single-mode and multimode fiber solutions carry high-speed backbone and inter-building connectivity, terminated and spliced to professional standards.
ri-server-line | Racks, Patch Panels & Cable Management | Organized rack layouts, professional termination, and labeled patch-panel architecture make moves, adds, and changes straightforward.
ri-file-shield-2-line | Testing, Certification & Documentation | Every installed link is tested and certified before handover, backed by complete port maps, cable schedules, and as-built records.

Engineered, Not Just Installed | Every cable run is planned around endpoint density, backbone distance, and future capacity.
Standards-Based Termination | Copper and fiber terminations follow proper industry standards for consistent performance.
Certified Before Handover | Every link is tested and certified to validate performance and installation quality.
Complete Documentation | Port maps, cable schedules, and as-built records ship with every project.
Built for Change | Patch-panel architecture makes moves, adds, and changes a routine task, not a rewiring project.
outcome: A physical foundation that's certified today and organized to expand tomorrow.

intro_heading: One Managed Environment for an Entire Property
intro_paragraphs:
A mall runs on more connections than any single tenant sees — visitors, retailers, facility teams, and security systems all depending on the same underlying network. Octel Networks manages the internet, network, Wi-Fi, and telephony infrastructure that ties an entire property together, so every stakeholder gets consistent connectivity without managing it themselves.

Most shopping malls end up with internet, tenant connections, and guest Wi-Fi installed independently over time, with no shared visibility across any of it. We manage mall infrastructure as one connected environment from the start, with internet redundancy, network segmentation, and centralized monitoring so issues are caught before tenants or visitors notice them.

ri-node-tree | Tenant Connectivity & Segmentation | Dedicated, segmented connectivity for every outlet, keeping tenant, guest, administrative, security, and IoT traffic properly isolated.
ri-phone-line | IP Telephony & Multi-Location Connectivity | Extensions, IP-PBX, and intercom systems connect security desks, facility teams, and administrative staff across the property.
whatwedo_heading: Why Property Owners Choose Octel for Mall Infrastructure

Proper Traffic Isolation | Tenant, guest, administrative, security, and IoT traffic stay properly segmented for security and performance.

Centralized Monitoring | Issues are caught before they become complaints at the property management desk.
